long_biography.plain_text:
At Vinci Play, design, metalworking, timber processing and assembly remain together in the production system. The company adapts its playground equipment to different countries’ safety standards. Keeping key manufacturing stages in-house gives the Polish business control over quality and supports its work for customers well beyond its home market.

Chodkowski began in playground equipment through BabyCam, a business registered under his own name. He and Piotr Nadulny developed Vinci Play while studying, then expanded its manufacturing operations and export reach. Chodkowski has served as the group’s board president, while the two men remain equal owners.
